verses.text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, to those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept safe for Jesus Christ:
May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
Dear friends, although I was eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt I had to write and urge you to fight for the faith that was once for all entrusted to God’s holy people.

Some people have slipped in unnoticed. Their judgment was written about long ago. They’re ungodly people who twist the grace of our God into permission for immoral behavior and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
Though you already know all this, I want to remind you that after the Lord saved a people out of Egypt, he later destroyed those who didn’t believe.
And the angels who didn’t stay within their own authority but abandoned their proper home, he has kept in eternal chains under darkness for judgment on the great Day.

In the same way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns gave themselves to sexual immorality and pursued unnatural desires. They serve as an example by undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
In the same way, these people rely on their dreams, pollute their bodies, reject authority, and insult glorious beings.
Even the archangel Michael, when he argued with the devil over Moses’ body, didn’t dare accuse him with insulting words. Instead he said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
But these people insult what they don’t understand. What they do understand by instinct, like unreasoning animals, is exactly what destroys them.
Woe to them! They’ve followed Cain’s path, rushed into Balaam’s error for profit, and been destroyed in Korah’s rebellion.

They’re dangerous hidden reefs at your love feasts, feasting with you without shame while caring only for themselves. They’re clouds without rain, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in late autumn, twice dead and uprooted;
wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shame; wandering stars, for whom the deepest darkness has been reserved forever.
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them too: “Look, the Lord is coming with countless thousands of his holy ones
to judge everyone and convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act they’ve done and every harsh word ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
These people are complainers and faultfinders, following their own desires. Their mouths brag, and they flatter people to get something for themselves.
But you, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ said beforehand.
They told you, “In the last times there will be mockers who follow their own ungodly desires.”
These are the people who divide you, follow their natural instincts, and don’t have the Spirit.
But you, dear friends, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.
Keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
Show mercy to those who doubt;
save others by snatching them from the fire. To others show mercy with fear, hating even the clothing stained by their corrupted desires.
To the one who can keep you from stumbling and bring you into his glorious presence without fault and with great joy,
to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, power, and authority before all time, now, and forever. Amen.
